# Comics Come Alive

> Comics Come Alive (comicscomealive.com) is a free, family-friendly website of original animated comics, old-school newspaper comic strips, 3D choose-your-own-adventure comic worlds and educational games for kids ages 1 to 7. Everything runs in a web browser on phones, tablets, computers and WebXR VR headsets, with no account or download. It is powered by Eye To Ad Media (https://eyetoad.com), a Denver-headquartered marketing and web studio.

Every character and story is original. The site guide is Captain Kapow, a caped comic hero. Content is always positive, built around kindness, confidence, generosity and humor. Kids sections have no ads and collect no information; the optional face swap photo stays on the visitor's device.

## Pages

- [Home](https://comicscomealive.com/): overview of every comic, world and game.
- [Animated Comics](https://comicscomealive.com/animated-comics/): interactive motion comic strips for kids, teens and adults: "Gus Can't Fire" (a baby dragon who sneezes instead of breathing fire), "Sent." (a group chat disaster), "The Yogurt Job" (a noir breakroom mystery with a flashlight panel), "Captain Kablam and the Very Big Ladder" (a pop-up 3D comic) and "Kapow vs. the Self-Checkout". Includes a slideshow mode and an optional read-aloud voice.
- [Daily Funnies](https://comicscomealive.com/newspaper-comics/): a vintage newspaper page with five original four-panel strips (Rascal's Route, Bolt, Hoot's Library, Rexx Reports, Sir Doodle), an add-color toggle, a word jumble and classifieds.
- [Sunday Comics](https://comicscomealive.com/sunday-comics/): full-color Sunday funnies ("Captain Kapow and the Sunday Pancakes", "Blip Learns Earth"), a Captain Kapow coloring page with PNG download, and links to public-domain historic comics at the Library of Congress and the Billy Ireland Cartoon Library.
- [Kids Learning Games](https://comicscomealive.com/kids-learning-games/): Kapow's Toybox Island, a 3D learning world for ages 1 to 7 with Color Garden, Counting Pond, Shape Blocks, ABC Balloons, Music Rainbow, Animal Friends and the Kindness Tree. Explore mode for toddlers, Learn mode with questions for ages 4 to 7.
- [Princess Castle](https://comicscomealive.com/princess-games/): a 3D castle world with Kitty Princess Phoenix Sparkles, princess dress up, a magic wand window game, tea party counting, nighttime and fireworks.
- [VR Comics](https://comicscomealive.com/vr-comics/): 3D choose-your-own-adventure comics: "The Yogurt Job" (find clues with a flashlight, question suspects, solve the case) and "Kablam's Sky Adventure" (27 paths to the moon).
- [Kapow's Dojo](https://comicscomealive.com/krav-maga-game/): a 3D Krav Maga point sparring game with bag training, belts, a bot opponent with three levels and 2-player mode. Sponsored by Do-Krav Combatives, a KAPAP Krav Maga school led by Sensei David (7th Dan) at 9165 Lowell Blvd, Westminster, CO 80031, 720-583-4977, https://mmatrainingdenver.com.
- [Bedtime Stories](https://comicscomealive.com/bedtime-stories/): The Sparkles Family Adventures, free read-along picture-book stories with word highlighting: "The Great Pancake Tower", "Camping with Coburn" and "The Lost Crown".
- [Make a Comic](https://comicscomealive.com/make-your-own-comic/): a free three-panel comic strip maker with backgrounds, characters, speech bubbles and sound effects, plus a grown-ups-only form to pitch comic ideas (unpaid, not confidential).
- [Advertise](https://comicscomealive.com/advertise/): custom branded comics, sponsored strips, sponsored 3D worlds and branded characters for businesses. Custom quotes. Sponsored content is always labeled. Phone 1-800-481-8638.
